items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I don't know very much about the family. They had the John Wein, was one of the best they had in the red light district.

ctx.x: No, Beche gave my brother lessons. But my brother thought music after he learned from Beche because he was real good. Now, do you, you heard any of the Wein boys that played piano? No, no, I don't know very much about the family. They had the John Wein, was one of the best they had in the red light district. On Vienna? Yeah, John Wein they called him.
How was he related to you or your father?
